conf.description: crowdstrike-falcon, fdr dataset, json format: parse the FDR NDJSON envelope, normalise ContextTimeStamp into _time, rewrite ImageFileName device-volume paths, map the ProcessRollup2 subset to ECS. cribl-pack volume-reduction (drop/sample by hash or name, aggregation, script hex-decode) is NOT implemented -- no concrete rule data is in the map.

conf.comment: crowdstrike-falcon / fdr / json. cribl-pack mechanism: no Packs are installed (GET /packs = 0) and the pack FUNCTION is an unrelated field-packing utility, so this builds the envelope + ProcessRollup2 ECS mapping natively per the brief. The pack's volume-reduction ruleset (hash/name drop lists, ExternalApiEvent sampling, network-event aggregation, ScriptContentBytes hex-decode) needs config data (lists/thresholds) this thin starter map does not supply, so it is NOT implemented here -- documented as a gap, not attempted with invented rules.

functions.description: record the cribl-pack build-native decision and the volume-reduction gap

compute derived fields from the ORIGINAL vendor names before renaming: ContextTimeStamp is fractional-seconds in some schema versions and whole ms in others, so normalise to epoch-seconds _time (never @timestamp) rather than event.ingested's cloud-receipt time; ImageFileName arrives as \Device\HarddiskVolumeN\... and is rewritten to a C:\ path to match Windows/Sysmon documents
batch-rename every clean envelope/ProcessRollup2 vendor key to its ECS/custom target
tag the dataset and drop the raw copy plus the two fields already replaced by their computed equivalents
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
